policy: Task-type skeleton — each option describes a KIND of work and how much reasoning it needs, so the Lead can match tasks to seats. provider, model and settings stay blank until filled from live discovery on the host (paseo provider ls --json, list_models); never copy IDs from examples.

options.notes: Cheap/fast seat: read-only exploration and reporting where a small or low-effort model is enough. Fill the model from discovery.
Default work seat: a coding-capable model at normal effort for well-bounded implementation tasks.
Heavy seat: a stronger model or a higher reasoning effort for design, root-cause work and review where mistakes are expensive.
Deliberately a different provider family than the implementation seats, so a reviewer is not the same model grading itself. Pick any available non-default family.
Devin-family seat for long autonomous runs. Devin options require a swe-2 model ID — fill the exact variant from discovery.
